propositions: Add typed provider-specific LLMRuntime auth/session capabilities in src/rebar/llm/auth.py that remain non-serializable and outside LLMConfig, RunRequest, snapshots, fingerprints, caches, and public output.

Extend PydanticAIRunner and get_runner to accept LLMRuntime and inject it into the single per-run ProviderSession builder without altering _pai_structured, request policy, cache accounting, exhaustion, artifacts, or tracing.
Ensure provider-native auth injection fails before a model request if explicit auth is absent or conflicting, with no fallback to anonymous, alternate-principal, or cross-provider candidates.
Verify exactly one Rebar-owned official client lifecycle per run and reject second runners, bespoke retry schedulers, or alternative Agent construction routes.

Confirm secret material and credentials remain absent from config, request, snapshot, fingerprint, cache, schema, output, logs, exceptions, and tracing boundaries; unwrap only inside the selected provider builder.
